subtasks: Pour all the balls from the cup into the vase.
Grasp the fallen yellow cup by its body and pour any remaining balls through the opening of the white vase.
Bring the empty yellow cup upright and set it down securely on clear tabletop space away from the loose balls.
Pick up the small brown balls from the tabletop with the left gripper and place them inside the upright yellow cup, one by one.

Grasp the yellow cup with the left gripper and use that same hand to pour its contents through the white vase opening. Set the cup upright on the tabletop and return both arms to their initial poses with grippers open.
